d: The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has left Michael Atherton and Nasser Hussain out of the commentary panel for the Pakistan tri-series, raising questions over the reported fallout from Atherton’s interview with Imran Khan’s sons. With the PCB facing scrutiny over its decision, the controversy has reignited the debate around politics and cricket in Pakistan. Is this simply a commentary selection, or is there a bigger story behind the snub? Rupha Ramani examines the controversy surrounding the PCB, Atherton, Hussain and Imran Khan.
